basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: “Unless you study, you’ll fail.” cümlesine en yakın anlam?
options: If you don’t study, you’ll fail.
In case you study, you’ll fail.
Provided you don’t study, you’ll fail.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: I’ll lend you the book as long as you ___ it back.
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: as long as sonrasında gelecek için present simple kullanılır.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: “Take an umbrella in case it rains.” cümlesinin doğru anlamı hangisi?
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: in case önlem anlamı taşır: yağabilir diye.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: She can come ___ she pays for her own ticket.
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: Şart bildirir: kendi biletini ödemesi şartıyla.

options: Unless it rains, we’ll have a picnic.
Unless it doesn’t rain, we’ll have a picnic.
Unless it will rain, we’ll have a picnic.
Unless it rained, we’ll have a picnic.
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: unless’ten sonra olumsuz fiil ve will kullanılmaz.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: Supposing you ___ the lottery, what would you do?
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: Gerçek dışı varsayımda supposing + past simple (won) gelir.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: You may enter ___ condition that you show your ID.

options: You can go provided that you finish your homework.
You can go provided that you will finish your homework.
You can go unless you don’t finish your homework.
You can go in case you finish your homework.
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: provided that’ten sonra present simple gelir.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: Bring cash ___ the card machine isn’t working.
basics_en_conditional_alternatives.why: in case: makine çalışmayabilir diye önlem.

basics_en_conditional_alternatives.prompt: Hangi bağlaç “if you don’t” anlamına gelir?
